findings.title: Branch protection disabled
findings.remediation: Enable protected-branch rules appropriate to the repository's change-control model.

findings.title: Required PR reviews disabled
findings.remediation: Require independent review before changes can be merged.

findings.title: Required status checks disabled
findings.remediation: Require appropriate CI and security status checks before protected branches can be merged.

findings.title: CODEOWNERS missing
findings.remediation: Define repository ownership and independent review responsibility for security-relevant paths.

findings.title: Secret scanning disabled
findings.remediation: Enable secret scanning or an equivalent detective control and define credential rotation handling.

findings.title: Secret push protection disabled
findings.remediation: Enable preventive secret push protection or an equivalent control for supported repositories.

findings.title: Critical vulnerability remediation overdue
findings.remediation: Prioritize remediation or documented risk treatment for overdue critical vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Automated dependency updates not configured
findings.remediation: Configure automated dependency update monitoring or an equivalent dependency maintenance process.

findings.title: Multi-factor authentication not enforced
findings.remediation: Enforce MFA for applicable identities, with stronger requirements for privileged access.

findings.title: Privileged access not periodically reviewed
findings.remediation: Establish periodic privileged-access review and evidence reviewer decisions.

findings.title: Workflow token permissions too broad
findings.remediation: Reduce default workflow token permissions to least privilege and document exceptions.

findings.title: Third-party Actions not SHA pinned
findings.remediation: Pin third-party workflow dependencies to immutable commit SHAs where practicable.

findings.title: Security logging disabled or insufficient
findings.remediation: Enable security-relevant logging and define retention, monitoring and alerting requirements.

findings.title: Backup restoration not tested
findings.remediation: Perform and evidence restoration testing at a frequency aligned to service criticality.

findings.title: Incident response plan not tested
findings.remediation: Run an incident-response exercise and capture lessons, actions and ownership.

findings.title: Critical supplier security risk not assessed
findings.remediation: Perform a risk-based supplier security assessment and document treatment decisions.

findings.title: Cloud administrator MFA missing
findings.remediation: Require strong MFA for administrative cloud identities and review emergency access paths.

findings.title: Internet-facing service insufficiently restricted
findings.remediation: Restrict exposed services to required ports, sources and trusted access paths.

findings.title: Sensitive data encryption missing
findings.remediation: Apply approved encryption controls to sensitive data at rest and in transit where required.

findings.title: AI system inventory missing
findings.remediation: Maintain an inventory of AI systems and use cases with ownership, purpose and risk context.
